description: This file defines the interface for a dispatcher component in a plugin system, including callback mechanisms, invocation, subscription management, and lifetime control.

classes.name: IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for a dispatcher handling invocation, subscription, and lifetime management in a plugin system.

classes.name: IDispatcher::ICallback
classes.description: Callback interface for event notifications within the dispatcher.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method on a specified channel with parameters, returning a response.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a callback to a specific event and designator.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a callback from a specific event and designator.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a service to the dispatcher, managing lifetime and connection.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a service from the dispatcher, releasing resources.

methods.name: Dropped
methods.description: Handles the scenario where a callback is unexpectedly dropped.
